title: Repairs by serial number
description: An electronics or phone store's repairs and services, kept in Desk against each unit's serial number. Each PP RPR Repair holds the serial (its item and its warranty date read from the serial, read only), what kind of job it is (Repair, Service, Test only or Recall work), the customer with their phone (the customer's, read only), the store that took the unit in, the day, the date it is promised for, the fault the customer reports and the unit's condition and accessories at intake; then the tests run and their results, the work done, the technician and the parts fitted, each with its own serial where it has one. A workflow moves it Received, In repair, Ready to collect and Collected, or Cancelled; once Collected or Cancelled, a save rule stops its serial, customer, dates, fault, tests, work and parts from changing, so the unit's history holds. The repair slip prints under the retailer's own letter head, with a tag for the unit. Every repair shows under its serial number, its customer and the sale that paid for it; the report Open repairs lists the repairs not yet collected, by the date promised. A field on Stock Entry, Repair, names the repair whose parts a Material Issue takes out of stock. The lock installs switched off, as every save rule does: the retailer switches it on. The app moves no money and changes no stock, and calls nothing outside: no service, no outside address.

fields.label: Test
fields.description: Such as battery health, charging, screen, camera, speaker, water damage.

fields.label: Part
fields.description: The part as an item in your stock, when it is one.

fields.label: What it is
fields.description: As the slip will describe it: a replacement screen, a battery.

fields.label: Part's serial number
fields.description: The fitted part's own serial, where it has one.

fields.label: Serial number
fields.description: The unit's serial number or IMEI, as iVendNext keeps it. Every repair of the unit shows under it.

fields.label: Warranty until
fields.description: The serial's own warranty date, as iVendNext keeps it. Change it on the serial number.

fields.label: Kind of job
fields.options:
Repair
Service
Test only
Recall work
fields.description: Recall work is a unit brought back because its maker recalled it.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Whose unit it is. Leave it blank for a unit of your own stock.

fields.label: Customer's phone
fields.description: The customer's phone, as the till keeps it. Your own Notification can tell them the unit is ready.

fields.label: Taken in at
fields.description: The store that took the unit in and hands it back.

fields.label: Ready by
fields.description: The date promised to the customer.

fields.label: Condition and accessories
fields.description: What the unit came in with and how it looked: a cracked corner, with its charger, no SIM card.

fields.label: Work done
fields.description: As the slip will tell the customer. When the unit could not be repaired, say so here.

fields.label: Paid by sale
fields.description: The till sale that charged for the repair, if it was charged. The till charges it as a service item.

fields.label: Collected by
fields.description: Who took the unit back, when it was not the customer.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: For the store only: never printed.

custom_fields.label: Repair
custom_fields.description: The repair whose parts this Material Issue takes out of stock. Optional.

save_rules.rule_name: PP RPR repair locked once collected
save_rules.message: This repair is closed: its unit, customer, fault, tests, work and parts stay as they were. Take a new repair for the serial instead.
